title: Executivo De Vendas - Segmento Rh (Pj)
description:
A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que transformam a experiência do cliente e do colaborador. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que otimizam processos de gestão e geram resultados reais.


Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para atuar com os produtos da Gupy, plataforma líder em tecnologia para Recursos Humanos, apoiando empresas a transformar sua gestão de pessoas com inovação, eficiência e resultados.


Responsabilidades


  • Prospecção e Análise de Necessidades: identificar oportunidades e compreender os desafios de RH dos clientes potenciais.
  • Demonstrações de Produtos: apresentar as soluções Gupy (Recrutamento & Seleção, Admissão Digital, Treinamento & Desenvolvimento e Gestão de Performance), evidenciando benefícios práticos e ROI.
  • Gestão do Funil de Vendas: conduzir todo o ciclo de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos.
  • Elaboração de Propostas: construir propostas comerciais alinhadas às necessidades do cliente.
  • Relacionamento Consultivo: atuar como parceiro estratégico dos clientes, entendendo dores e sugerindo soluções adequadas.
  • Feedback e Melhoria: trazer percepções do mercado e dos clientes para aprimorar constantemente a abordagem e os processos.


Requisitos


  • Formação: Graduação completa ou em andamento (a partir do 2º ano) em Administração, Gestão de Pessoas, Finanças ou áreas de Tecnologia.
  • Experiência: vivência em vendas consultivas, preferencialmente em software B2B, SaaS ou soluções para RH.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: desejável familiaridade com plataformas de RH (ATS, LMS, HCM) ou softwares SaaS.
  • Comunicação: excelente habilidade verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar soluções complexas de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Foco no Cliente: capacidade de entender processos de RH e gerar valor para diferentes perfis de empresas.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: perfil colaborativo, orientado a metas e resultados.
  • Inglês: nível intermediário será um diferencial.


O que oferecemos


  • Remuneração compatível e remuneração agressiva
  • Ambiente inovador e colaborativo


Por que se juntar à Bravo Solutions?


Você terá a oportunidade de atuar com a Gupy, referência em tecnologia para Recursos Humanos, impactando diretamente empresas de diversos portes na forma como contratam, desenvolvem e engajam seus talentos.


Se você é apaixonado por vendas, tecnologia e quer fazer parte de uma empresa em expansão, vem crescer com a Bravo!

title: Fullstack Developer (São Paulo)
description:
Enabley is hiring: Fullstack Developer (São Paulo)

Enabley is a fast-growing learning technology startup headquartered in Israel with a substantial and growing customer base in Brazil.

We’re looking for a skilled Fullstack Developer to join our international product development group, working full-time with our local team in São Paulo!

Our platform serves companies with deskless workforces in industries like retail, transportation, manufacturing, healthcare etc. (e.G., Vivo, Coca-Cola, Chilli Beans, Unilever and many others). We help employees learn and grow on the go, whether through desktop or mobile, ensuring they stay connected to their company, no matter where they are.


What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers across global teams to roll out new features quickly and improve existing ones.
  • Develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications with full responsiveness for both desktop and mobile.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of features—from understanding the need to delivering production-ready code.
  • Build and enhance systems using Java, Spring, React, Redux, Node.Js, MongoDB, and AWS cloud services.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and follow best practices for software development.
  • Use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate productivity and code quality.
  • Support and extend product features that leverage generative AI , such as intelligent knowledge assistants, automated content generation and more.
  • Work with tight schedules and changing priorities, actively seeking solutions .


What We Offer

  • A dynamic and supportive work environment with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and getting the job done with a smile :)
  • The chance to impact learning experiences for millions of deskless workers , across industries and continents.
  • Daily exposure to modern AI development practices and a product stack that actively incorporates AI into customer-facing features.
  • A hybrid work model – at least 2 days a week in our São Paulo offices (Berrini/Pinheiros area;
    this is a must)     , with the rest remote.


Who You Are

  • Experienced Fullstack Developer: 5+ years building software products in real-world, production environments.
  • Tech Stack : Proficiency in Java , Spring , React , Redux , MongoDB , Node.Js , AWS, and CI/CD workflows .
  • AI Mindset: Familiar with using AI tools to enhance development workflows. Enthusiastic about helping build AI-powered product features and curious about how AI is transforming software user interactions.
  • Cloud: Experience developing and operating in AWS environments, using services like S3, EC2, Lambda, CloudWatch, etc.
  • Fluent in English: Strong communication skills in English are essential, as it is our primary working language.
  • Self-Starter : You’re motivated, resourceful, and capable of taking initiative—even when specifications are still being gathered.
  • Team Player: Collaborative, curious, thrives in fast-paced environments, and fun to work with :)


Ready to code the future of learning?

Apply now and join us in shaping the future of learning for deskless workers!

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter Para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de grandes contas, através das atuações porta a porta, Leads direcionados e também por construções de conexões e relacionamentos;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio;
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia;
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente;
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão;



Requisitos:

  • Possuir graduação completa;
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento;
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas
  • Ter experiência em negociar e fechar contratos;
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial (100% Externo).
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.G. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Chief Legal Officer
description:

In order to accelerate growth even more, the firm is seeking a Chief Legal Officer . The Ideal candidate is someone who can lead all legal related initiatives, navigate complex landscapes, build & manage a high performing team, serve as a trusted advisor to the founders and get things done (not as an advisor but as a legal executive-operator).


Responsibilities

  • Manage all legal matters (mostly domestic but some international exposure as well).
  • Build, structure, and lead a high-performing in-house legal team, including: (i) Defining clear scopes between in-house vs. external counsel;
    (ii) Hiring, developing, and, when necessary, upgrading talent;
    (iii) Implementing SLAs, prioritization frameworks, and legal intake processes;
    (iv) Ensuring legal is a force multiplier, not a bottleneck
  • Process Professionalization: Transition the legal department from "startup mode" to a disciplined "financial institution standard".
  • Risk Optimization: Translate legal constraints into business options. Quantify downside, propose alternatives, and recommend paths that maximize long-term enterprise value
  • Regulatory: Manage the process of applying for SCD (Sociedade de Crédito Direto) License, exposure to Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Open Finance, Consumer protection at scale (BACEN + SENACON dynamics), Structuring new financial products under regulatory ambiguity
  • Be ready to contribute to potential capital raise/M&A processes, manage data rooms, oversee due diligence, and negotiate complex term sheets.


Qualifications

  • 15–20 years of experience.
  • Ideal candidate will bring a generalist expertise being able to navigate Brazilian Employment law, Tax basics, Contract law (Brazil & International), Regulatory, M&A.
  • Ideal candidate has a combination of top-tier law firm and in-house
  • Start-up experience (ideally at a Fintech)
  • Proven People Leadership
  • Language: English fluency is a must.
  • Location: São Paulo. (Hybrid work environment)


This role is NOT for:

  • Pure advisory profiles who prefer external counsel to execution
  • Lawyers who have not personally built, hired, and performance-managed teams
  • Professionals uncomfortable making fast risk trade-offs with imperfect information
  • Candidates who need heavy structure before acting

title: Ripplex Partner Director
description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Are you a strategic leader with deep experience in relationship management and a passion for tokenization, institutional finance, and blockchain technology? As a Partner Director on the RippleX Partner Success team, you'll play a key role in accelerating the growth and impact of the XRPL ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of high-profile partners—including financial institutions, fintechs, and crypto-native builders—guiding them through every stage of their journey: from idea to integration to go-live and scale.

This is not a passive role. You will be hands-on in shaping tokenization strategies, architecting utility on-chain, and removing roadblocks in dynamic, high-stakes environments. Your day-to-day will span deep technical discussions and executive-level strategic planning—always with the goal of maximizing partner success and driving meaningful, on-ledger activity.

If you're excited to unlock real-world utility through tokenized assets and thrive at the intersection of institutional finance and blockchain innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own and lead a portfolio of highly strategic and complex Institutional DeFi partners building on XRPL, with a focus on scaled adoption of tokenized asset use cases.
  • Define and drive strategic account plans that maximize long-term value for both Ripple and its partners.
  • Lead execution across technical and GTM workstreams, anticipating risks and aligning cross-functional resources to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Provide thought leadership and guidance to partners around tokenization, utility, regulatory considerations, and financial market structures.
  • Build and maintain strong executive relationships with C-level stakeholders at partner organizations, and act as a senior voice across Ripple internal teams.
  • Represent partner needs and priorities internally, influencing RippleX’s roadmap, product strategy, and go-to-market motions.
  • Identify opportunities for broader ecosystem impact and partner cross-collaboration to accelerate XRPL utility.
  • Travel to partner and customer sites as needed (20–30%).

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 10–12+ years of experience leading strategic partnerships or enterprise engagements in fintech, financial services, or blockchain—ideally with a focus on innovation and emerging tech.
  • Institutional Finance Acumen: Deep understanding of financial instruments and market structure (equities, bonds, repos, collateralized lending, etc.). Strong grasp of collateral management, capital efficiency, and how DeFi can impact these processes. Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (Basel III, MiFID, EMIR, etc.) and how they relate to tokenisation and digital asset adoption
  • Tokenization Expertise: Strong command of tokenization models, use cases, and best practices. Able to influence strategy and guide partner implementation across the asset lifecycle.
  • Blockchain Fluency: Deep understanding of blockchain fundamentals and how they can be applied to financial use cases such as tokenization, settlement, and collateral management. Ability to evaluate different protocol features (e.G., scalability, finality, cost, security) and articulate how they impact institutional DeFi applications. Experience advising on interoperability protocols and bridging technologies (e.G., Axelar) to support cross-chain integration and ecosystem connectivity.
  • Go-to-Market & Utility Creation: Proven track record of launching scalable GTM strategies that result in sustained on-chain activity and partner adoption. Ability to cross-pollinate within Ripple and across partners.
  • Partner Enablement & Growth: Extensive experience leading strategic partnerships and enterprise relationships, with a focus on enabling partners from ideation through to build, compliance readiness, and scaled deployment. Adept at managing complex stakeholder dynamics across technical, product, and executive functions. Proven ability to proactively remove obstacles and shape partner strategy to drive momentum, unlock long-term value, and deliver measurable impact on ecosystem growth.
  • Problem Solving with Agency: Bias for action and proactive problem solving, especially when navigating ambiguity or institutional inertia. Strong “ownership mindset” to help partners go from idea to deployment with confidence. Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset—skilled at managing through ambiguity, resolving friction, and anticipating downstream impact.
  • Executive Presence & Trust Building: Experienced engaging at the C-suite level at tier 1 banks and asset managers, with credibility, empathy, and strategic insight. Trusted advisor in high-stakes conversations. Skilled in managing sensitive conversations (regulatory risk, commercial conflicts, etc.).
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Comfortable driving alignment and influencing roadmaps across multiple internal teams to ensure success at scale.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. Please find our UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice and our California Applicant Privacy Notice for reference.

Sobre a Ardagh:


A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. title: Lower School Makerspace Teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).

Somos a Greystar, um conceito de apartamentos de aluguel totalmente equipados, com um serviço de gerenciamento profissional que está estabelecendo o padrão no mercado. Desde a nossa fundação, buscamos oferecer um estilo de vida exclusivo, focado em proporcionar aos nossos residentes uma experiência única.


Nosso principal objetivo? É oferecer um estilo de vida exclusivo focado em nossos residentes vivendo uma experiência única.


Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base em nossos pilares e valores;
nossos pilares servem de guia para “o que fazemos” e nossos valores orientam “a forma como fazemos”. Acreditamos firmemente que a diversidade agrega valor. É por isso que nossos valores promovem um ambiente de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão, estabelecendo uma base e uma mentalidade pela qual orientamos os membros da equipe, nossos residentes, comunidades e parceiros. Somos uma empresa comprometida em criar um ótimo local de trabalho para todos e reforçamos isso com nossas iniciativas de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão.


Chamou sua atenção? Quer saber mais sobre as funções?


Perfil procurado:

  • Momento de carreira: Profissional com experiência prática em vendas e atendimento. Alguém em fase de crescimento na carreira, com energia e ambição para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Formação e experiências anteriores: Preferencialmente com passagem por startups, ou empresas de tecnologia ligadas ao setor imobiliário principalmente de curta estadia, para entender mais do nosso dinamismo. Experiência com inside sales , atendimento digital e foco em fechamento são diferenciais.
  • Habilidades técnicas: Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de CRM, domínio do pacote Office (com foco em Excel) e boa fluência em Outlook. É essencial ter excelente escrita – clara, profissional e persuasiva, tanto para e-mails quanto para WhatsApp, além de boa comunicação presencial.
  • Comunicação e perfil comercial: Boa escuta, empatia e firmeza para negociar. Buscamos alguém com perfil closer , com habilidade para contornar objeções, ler o momento do lead e conduzi-lo até o fechamento.
  • Comportamento e atitude: Perfil colaborativo, alto astral, despojado, com senso de dono e foco em metas. Flexível e adaptável a mudanças de processo, com facilidade em lidar com tecnologia. Valoriza o trabalho em equipe, mas tem autonomia para tocar suas entregas com responsabilidade.
  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário, sendo capaz de conversar com clientes estrangeiros e explicar de forma clara o processo de locação.



Funções:

  • Gestão Comercial: Gerir o ciclo completo de vida do cliente, desde a prospecção, acompanhamento e fechamento, visando a máxima ocupação das unidades (seguindo os padrões de qualidade da empresa).
  • Visitas Comerciais: Realizar visitas comerciais aos imóveis, mostrando os apartamentos, explicando o conceito e também as áreas comuns.
  • Gestão de Clientes: Contribuir proativamente para a construção e desenvolvimento da melhor experiência para os nossos clientes, organizando eventos, remoções e atividades diversas.
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Monitorar diariamente os principais indicadores de gestão através do CRM.

  • Plano de Saúde – 100% subsidiado para titulares e dependentes.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

**Candidate must be located in Joinville, Santa Catarina**

We are looking for a talented, communicative, and highly driven Senior Account Executive to join our team at Syndigo . In this role, you’ll serve as a trusted partner to our clients—managing relationships, driving consultative sales, resolving issues, and supporting questions throughout the customer lifecycle. We value professionals who are agile, proactive, and passionate about delivering exceptional solutions.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

  • Manage the full consultative sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.
  • Actively identify and engage potential customers to build a strong pipeline.
  • Lead regular meetings with suppliers and clients to introduce new solutions and strengthen relationships.
  • Conduct timely and accurate follow‑ups based on sales funnel stages.
  • Prepare, present, and deliver high‑quality commercial proposals.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms to successfully close opportunities.
  • Maintain an organized schedule and ensure all lead/client information is accurately updated in the CRM.
  • Lead retention discussions and negotiate solutions with suppliers at risk of churn .
  • Participate in onsite client visits as needed.
  • Represent Syndigo at trade shows, fairs, and other industry events.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, product offerings, or customer experience.

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

  • 4+ years of relevant experience
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Advanced English and Brazilian Portuguese proficiency
  • Proven experience in commercial sales roles
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong technical proficiency (Microsoft 365)
  • Effective problem-solving, planning, and organization abilities
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

title: Loss Prevention Avsec Supervisor
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention AVSEC Supervisor. In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Ensure compliance with ANAC regulations and the Air Cargo Security Program (PSESCA), applicable to warehouse logistics operations in the airport area.
  • Coordinate and supervise security inspections of cargo, in accordance with established screening and control requirements.
  • Ensure that all employees and contractors receive mandatory AVSEC training and refresher courses within regulatory deadlines.
  • Monitor and audit compliance with restricted access rules in controlled areas of the airport.
  • Implement procedures for controlling prohibited items and restricted materials, ensuring traceability and proper record-keeping.
  • Act as a point of contact with airport authorities and regulatory agencies (ANAC, Federal Police, Customs, and GRU Airport) on operational security matters.
  • Develop response plans for incidents related to civil aviation security, including threats of unlawful interference, sabotage, or unauthorized access.
  • Conduct specific risk assessments for warehouse operations in the airport and propose mitigating measures.
  • Keep certifications and approvals required for the secure handling of air cargo up to date.
  • Support investigations of incidents or suspected AVSEC violations, preparing detailed reports.
  • Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.G., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards;
  • Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management (e.G., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters;


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Relevant security- or risk-related education or experience (e.G., security services, asset protection, loss prevention, risk management, inventory management, investigations, supply chain, auditing, compliance, or similar)
  • Relevant experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment
  • Advanced proficiency in written and verbal English. Spanish is a plus

title: Analista Sênior - Crédito Estruturado
description:
Vaga afirmativa para mulheres


Estamos expandindo nosso time de investimentos em Crédito e Renda Fixa e buscamos profissionais que queiram contribuir para a nossa trajetória de crescimento e para o fortalecimento da atuação da VOX Capital no mercado.


A Analista integrará a equipe de Crédito e Renda Fixa da VOX Capital, com foco em produtos estruturados de crédito privado, atuando na prospecção, originação e análise de investimentos, com foco em agronegócio sustentável e livre de desmatamento, além de outras teses estratégicas da área - sempre guiada pelo nosso princípio de que todo investimento gera impacto.


Se você é apaixonada por empreendedorismo, tem experiência com produtos estruturados de crédito privado e acredita que o fluxo de capital pode gerar impactos positivos para as pessoas e o planeta, junte-se à gestora de investimentos de impacto mais ativa do Brasil!


Sobre a Área de Crédito e Renda Fixa

Acreditamos que os fluxos financeiros têm papel relevante na transformação do nosso mundo. A área de Crédito e Renda Fixa da VOX tem papel fundamental como plataforma de conexão e facilitação dos fluxos financeiros, com objetivo de geração de impacto socioambiental positivo. É o nosso eixo central de fluxos, tempos e movimentos de capital - e, consequentemente, de impacto para as pessoas e para o planeta.

Nossas estratégias de investimento abrangem desde o crédito high grade a soluções de alto impacto voltadas à agricultura sustentável e livre de desmatamento. Nossa abordagem única combina análise financeira tradicional com uma avaliação criteriosa do impacto socioambiental de cada investimento. Isso nos permite oferecer aos investidores não apenas retorno financeiro, mas também a certeza de que estão contribuindo para um desenvolvimento mais sustentável e inclusivo.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na originação e análise de oportunidades de investimento em produtos estruturados de crédito privado, com foco em Agronegócio Sustentável e outras teses da área;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o desenvolvimento e manutenção de relacionamentos de longo prazo com instituições parceiras;
  • Liderar a execução das operações, incluindo processos de DD, elaboração de materiais e interação com clientes, investidores e contrapartes relevantes;
  • Contribuir para a avaliação e apresentação de oportunidades de investimento ao Comitê de Investimento e de Impacto;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com outras áreas da VOX Capital, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas e transversais da gestora.


Requisitos da Vaga

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em gestão de investimentos, DCM ou áreas correlatas, com atuação em análise e/ou estruturação de operações de crédito privado (FIAGRO, FIDC, CRI, CRA, Debêntures, entre outros);
  • Interesse e/ou experiência em investimentos de impacto, especialmente em teses de Agronegócio Sustentável e livre de desmatamento;
  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e habilidade para interação com stakeholders do mercado.
  • Conhecimento sólido em inglês para atividades profissionais do dia a dia
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com alto grau de responsabilidade e organização, em um ambiente de baixa supervisão.


Competências

  • Capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico;
  • Comunicação clara e eficaz;
  • Autonomia, proatividade e organização;
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe.


Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica;
  • Cartão Flash benefícios flexíveis;
  • Auxílio para trabalho remoto (para pagamento de contas de água, luz, telefone ou gás);
  • Incentivo financeiro para cultura, treinamentos e desenvolvimentos;
  • Atualmente o nosso time está trabalhando de forma híbrida e com flexibilidade. É desejável que se tenha disponibilidade para trabalho híbrido no escritório da VOX na cidade de São Paulo.


INSCRIÇÃO NA VAGA

Para participar do processo seletivo, envie seu CV para com o título: " (Seu Nome) - Vaga Analista de Crédito Estruturado" .


Sobre a Vox Capital

Somos a gestora pioneira em investimento de impacto no Brasil desde 2009 e uma das maiores da América latina, com R$1,8 bilhão de ativos sob gestão. Nosso foco está em gerir recursos financeiros de forma que contribuam na solução dos principais desafios da sociedade e do planeta. Atuamos em setores como saúde, educação, inclusão financeira, nutrição sustentável e transição climática, entre outras verticais e indústrias que integram nossa tese de investimentos de impacto socioambiental.


Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

A VOX Capital está em busca de novos talentos para integrar nossa equipe e contribuir para nossa missão de gerar impacto positivo. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão em nosso ambiente de trabalho, por isso, incentivamos fortemente candidaturas de mulheres e pessoas negras, que terão prioridade no processo seletivo desta posição. Nosso compromisso é criar um espaço mais inclusivo e representativo, e buscamos pessoas que compartilhem desse propósito. Se você acredita no poder da diversidade e quer fazer parte de um time que atua para transformar a sociedade, queremos conhecer você!

title: Closer - Inside Sales
description:
Sobre a Piece


Somos um grupo de marcas de infoproduto e tecnologia que já soma R$ 15 milhões/ano em receita no portfólio. Temos operação presencial em São José dos Campos e estamos acelerando para atingir R$ 60 milhões de receita em 2026 .


Vemos a convergência dos dois dos mercados mais aquecidos do mundo — IA e Creator Economy . De um lado, o software oferece infraestrutura, tecnologia e receita recorrente, mas carece de distribuição e demanda capital. Do outro, creators/infoprodutores possuem audiência massiva, confiança e comunidades engajadas, geram muito caixa, porém com menor visão de longo prazo e pouco LTV . Nossa tese é unir o melhor desses dois mundos para construir um conglomerado global de empresas na intersecção de infoproduto e tecnologia . Acreditamos que os próximos gigantes da América Latina surgirão dessa convergência.


Nosso momento é de crescimento acelerado, e estamos construindo as bases financeiras que sustentarão esse crescimento. Nosso ambiente é dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a resultados. Valorizamos pessoas que aprendem rápido, questionam o status quo e transformam complexidade em clareza.



O Desafio / O que você fará

Estamos em busca de um Closer (Executivo de Vendas) para converter oportunidades em clientes reais da Piece Digital . Procuramos um profissional com alto poder de persuasão, mentalidade consultiva e foco total em resultados, capaz de conduzir negociações do diagnóstico ao fechamento.

O perfil ideal é de um profissional "faca na caveira", mas que sabe ouvir. Você não é apenas um vendedor, mas um especialista que entende as dores do cliente e apresenta a Piece Digital como a solução estratégica definitiva. Sua missão é pegar o bastão passado pelos SDRs e garantir que a taxa de conversão seja máxima.

O Closer terá autonomia para conduzir suas negociações, gerenciar seu próprio funil de vendas e terá impacto direto no faturamento e na escala da empresa. Você trabalhará com metas claras e um modelo de comissionamento agressivo para quem entrega alta performance.



O que você vai Fazer

  • Venda Consultiva: Realizar reuniões de diagnóstico e demonstração, focando em entender as necessidades do cliente e gerar valor imediato.
  • Gestão de Oportunidades: Gerenciar o funil de vendas (pipeline) de forma eficiente, garantindo que as propostas avancem pelas etapas de decisão.
  • Negociação e Fechamento: Liderar as etapas finais de negociação, contornando objeções complexas e estruturando propostas comerciais vencedoras.
  • Interface com SDRs: Dar feedback constante ao time de prospecção para refinar a qualidade dos leads que chegam para a mesa de fechamento.
  • Uso Estratégico de CRM: Manter o histórico de todas as interações atualizado, utilizando os dados para prever faturamento (forecast) e otimizar o tempo de fechamento.



Requisitos

  • Experiência como Closer em vendas B2B (preferencialmente serviços digitais ou tecnologia).
  • Domínio de metodologias de vendas complexas (como SPIN Selling, Challenger Sale ou GPCTBA ).
  • Habilidade de comunicação, oratória e escrita para apresentações executivas.
  • Capacidade de lidar com ciclos de venda curtos e médios, mantendo a disciplina no follow-up.
  • Competências comportamentais: Resiliência, orientação por metas (target-driven), alto poder de influência e rapidez de raciocínio para negociações sob pressão.



Diferenciais:

  • Experiência anterior em agências de marketing digital ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Experiência em vendas High Ticket.
  • Histórico de ter superado metas de forma consistente em experiências passadas.

⸻

- Acuracidade de inspeção.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora Comercial
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Conduzir as negociações comerciais (renovação, retenção de lojistas, mudanças de locatários e movimentações estratégicas de lojistas, discussões contratuais, etc) através de reuniões com os lojistas buscando garantir o planejamento anual do Shopping e atingimento do resultado esperado pelos empreendedores;

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil


REPortS TO:

R&D Manager


Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.


Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.


Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.G., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.


Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Product Owner
description:

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • Atleast 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect


Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.


The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:


As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:


TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR


DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns


DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models


Knowledge and Experience


ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English


DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Analista De Processo De Manufatura Pleno
description:
Este é o Grupo Husqvarna, o maior produtor mundial de produtos de energia ao ar livre para silvicultura, gramado e jardim e construção. Como uma das start-ups mais antigas do mundo, estamos em uma jornada emocionante, trabalhando juntos em um ambiente global acelerado, onde nos desafiamos continuamente a continuar inovando e reinventando nossos negócios.

Com nossa paixão pela inovação, criamos produtos e serviços para clientes em todo o mundo. Somos um empregador de oportunidades iguais e entendemos que nossas diferenças são nossos pontos fortes. Somos curiosos, ousados e construídos por nossas diferenças. Celebramos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os funcionários e candidatos. Juntos como uma equipe, podemos dar vida às melhores ideias.

Hoje, o Grupo está com uma oportunidade como Analista em Processos de Manufatura que pode ser a sua cara, confira abaixo:

O escopo da função é de principalmente apoiar no processo de expansão da planta com o desenho e estruturação de processos de produção das novas linhas de montagem.


O que você vai fazer:

Será responsável pelos processos e projetos de todas as linhas de montagem (assembly lines) da nossa manufatura: executar simulações, gerenciar restrições de custo e tempo e realizar avaliações de risco;

Realização de cronoanálise: determinar quanto tempo e esforços são necessários para a execução de cada tarefa na linha;

Análise de tempose métodos: análise de tempos e movimentos em nossa linha de produção, com o objetivo de otimizar processos e eliminar desperdícios;

Desenvolvimento emelhoria de padrões de trabalho/instruções técnicas/procedimentos operacionais;

Atualização e confecção de documentações técnicas da nossa manufatura;

Realização do controle dimensional: verificar de modo eficiente as características dimensionais de peças, subconjuntos ou equipamentos, de modo a garantir a montagem, o bom funcionamento, a manutenção e a intercambiabilidade de peças e componentes;

Desenvolver, executar, testar e atualizar sistemas e processos;

Desenvolver melhores práticas, rotinas e soluções inovadoras para melhorar as taxas de produção e a qualidade dos resultados;

Estudar e compreender processos e melhores práticas existentes em outras plantas da Husqvarna pelo mundo e trazer/adaptar para o Brasil.

O que é importante você saber:

Formação superior em engenharia (preferencialmente mecânica ou produção);

Ter inglês avançado (B2) (conversação e escrita) para visitas, chamadas/conferências e reuniões/apresentações com times internacionais;

Experiência prévia como processista em indústrias correlatas (automotiva, linha branca etc);

Excelentes habilidades técnicas, raciocínio analítico com habilidades interpessoais;

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- Domínio em Java (8+) e ecossistema Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Cloud, Batch, MVC);

- Conhecimento emDesign Patterns e princípios SOLID;

- Experiência comarquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluindo uso de serviços como ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3 ou CloudWatch;

- Vivência com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS) para integração entre sistemas e processamento assíncrono;

- Experiência combancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis);

- Prática em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e versionamento com Git;

- Experiência comconteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm);

- Conhecimento emtestes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integração e performance);

O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Home Office;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Data Scientist
description:
Mission Description:

Join our Advanced Analytics team as a Data Scientist in the Commercial Performance Tower. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning models that drive business impact. This is a hands-on role focused on model development, deployment, and optimization in real-world commercial environments.


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Scientist to strengthen our analytics capabilities. You will work on high-impact projects involving recommendation systems, demand forecasting, and predictive modeling using state-of-the-art techniques. The ideal candidate is passionate about turning data into actionable insights and has strong experience in model deployment within cloud environments (Azure, Databricks). You will collaborate closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data science solutions that optimize commercial performance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, content-based, hybrid approaches)
  • Build and validate time series forecasting models using ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, and other ML-based methods
  • Implement and tune boosting algorithms (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and decision tree-based models for classification and regression tasks
  • Perform end-to-end data exploration, feature engineering, and model evaluation
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production on Azure and Databricks
  • Translate business problems into analytical frameworks and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Stay current with emerging trends and tools in machine learning and data science



Profile Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics , or a related quantitative field


Experience & Skills:

  • Proven experience in recommender systems and time series forecasting
  • Strong expertise in boosting algorithms (XGBoost, etc.) and decision trees
  • Proficiency in Python and key libraries: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning , Databricks , and cloud-based model deployment
  • Familiarity with C++ (a plus for performance-critical components)
  • Solid understanding of ML lifecycle , from prototyping to production
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) – essential for global collaboration


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing analytics team driving real business impact
  • Work on cutting-edge machine learning applications in a dynamic commercial environment
  • Access to modern tools and cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks)
  • Opportunities for growth within the Mantu Group ecosystem

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida em AWS : S3, Glue Data Catalog, Airflow (preferencialmente MWAA), DAGs em Python, Amazon Redshift.
  • Linguagens: Python e SQL avançado .
  • Power BI : modelagem semântica, DAX, incremental refresh, gateway, boas práticas para consumo de Redshift.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lakehouse , formatos colunares (Parquet), partições e metadados.
  • Boas práticas de engenharia: Git, testes, code reviews, documentação, pipelines confiáveis.
  • Segurança e governança: IAM, criptografia, princípios de mínimo privilégio, LGPD aplicada a dados.

title: Engenheiro De Controle
description:
About Woodgrove


We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.


Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.


All resumes must be in english.


Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.G., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.
  • Verification and validation of software through inspection, simulation, and testing
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and implement control systems for new projects.
  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

title: Assistente De Folha De Pagamento (Dp)

A ContabilizaEcom é uma empresa de contabilidade especialmente voltada para o e‑commerce, que combina expertise fiscal, tributária e empresarial para apoiar lojas online no Brasil.

Alguns destaques da empresa:

  • Foi criada por quem “nasceu em um e‑commerce”, ou seja, compreende os desafios práticos desse tipo de negócio.
  • Oferece serviços como abertura de empresa, análise fiscal de produtos, configuração de ERP e canais de venda, recuperação de impostos pagos indevidamente, planejamento tributário e busca de benefícios fiscais.
  • Foca em economia de impostos, segurança jurídica e regularização fiscal dos seus clientes.
  • Tem métricas que demonstram credibilidade: mais de 300 sellers ativos, cerca de 96% de satisfação dos clientes e mais de R$ 10 milhões em impostos economizados.


Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos procurando um Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP) para se juntar à equipe da ContabilizaEcom em Curitiba. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias relacionadas a folha de pagamento no setor de departamento pessoal que busque a garantia de conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e legais vigentes.


Este é um cargo de tempo integral presencial, permitindo algumas atividades administrativas realizadas remotamente, onde o colaborador tem espaço para o crescimento em um ambiente descontraído com limites e responsabilidades.

  • Cálculo de Encargos: Calcular e conferir o INSS, FGTS e IRRF.
  • Fechamento e Conferência: Realizar o fechamento da folha e emitir os relatórios de conferência (holerites), assegurando a conformidade legal.
  • Emissão de Guias: Gerar e enviar as guias de recolhimento dos encargos sociais e impostos (Ex: DAF, GPS/DARF Previdenciário).
  • Rotinas de Pessoal: executar cálculo e registro de férias e processamento de rescisões contratuais, com o devido registro no sistema.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL


BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.


Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.


Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.


Why joining us?


Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.


Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.


Why do we want you?


We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.



Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:


1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders;
use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.


Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:


1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.


Competences:


a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.


Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners’ physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.


Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.


· What do we offer?


1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.


Let’s move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall
