Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.


Como é atuar conosco


Por meio da nossa área de Alocação de Talentos, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.


Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Supervisão das rotinas contábeis de diferentes plantas do grupo, com foco na unidade de Curitiba e acompanhamento das demais unidades quando necessário.
  • Revisão e validação de lançamentos contábeis, conciliações e reconciliações de contas patrimoniais e de resultado.
  • Acompanhamento do fechamento contábil mensal (até o 3º dia útil), garantindo a integridade e consistência das informações.
  • Elaboração e revisão de demonstrações financeiras (balanço patrimonial, DRE, DFC, notas explicativas), em conformidade com as normas contábeis brasileiras (CPCs) e internacionais (IFRS).
  • Monitoramento de provisões, depreciações, amortizações e ajustes contábeis, assegurando o correto tratamento técnico e compliance regulatório.
  • Gestão e acompanhamento de obrigações acessórias contábeis (ECD, ECF), assegurando prazos e qualidade da entrega.
  • Análise crítica de processos e controles internos, propondo melhorias para otimização e mitigação de riscos.
  • Interface direta com a equipe contábil e demais áreas envolvidas, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo, de desenvolvimento técnico e foco em resultados.


Requisitos / Qualificações


  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Possuir CRC Ativo;
  • Excel Avançado;
  • Conhecimento técnico e prático nas atividades Contábeis;
  • Inglês avançado(será testado em entrevista)



O que esperamos de você


  • Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
  • Proatividade naresolução de problemas e execução das atividades;
  • Boa comunicaçãoe relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Responsabilidade, organização e adaptabilidade;
  • Disposição paracolaborar com diferentes equipes e projetos;

Você fará parte de uma equipe selecionada de corretores que atuam nos principais bairros da capital (Vila Olímpia, Itaim Bibi, Faria Lima, Brooklin, Pinheiros, Paulista), com a maior taxa de comissionamento do mercado (até 45%), ajuda de custo e treinamento. Como Ter Sucesso no Cargo

Para ter sucesso, o candidato deve ter comprometimento, habilidade de comunicação e negociação, bom atendimento ao cliente, ser dinâmico, organizado e proativo.

Como Consultor Imobiliário, você atuará como um ponto de contato chave entre a empresa e os clientes, contribuindo para o crescimento da carteira de imóveis e a consolidação da reputação da empresa no mercado. Sua atuação será vital para o sucesso das operações imobiliárias da organização.


Responsabilidades


  • Identificar e prospectar oportunidades de negócios no setor imobiliário corporativo.


  • Conduzir visitas a imóveis e apresentar propostas aos clientes.


  • Negociar condições de compra, venda e locação de imóveis, garantindo a satisfação de todas as partes envolvidas.


  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário e a legislação vigente.


  • Elaborar relatórios e manter registros de negociações e atividades de clientes.


Qualificações


  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.


  • Comunicação verbal e escrita eficientes.


  • Habilidades de negociação.


  • Organização.


  • Competência para realizar análises de mercado.


  • Proatividade.


  • Entender as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas.

  • Postura profissional e apresentação pessoal adequada

Presencial - São Paulo, Vila Olímpia


Se você se considera com disposição para evoluir todos os dias e alcançar patamares de excelência, nós queremos você em nosso time!

title: Técnico(A) De Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Técnico de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.


Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.E. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento,monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você distingue prontamente entre o que é relevante e o que é irrelevante para compreender situações complexas. Você encontra pontos em comum e conduz as coisas para o consenso, garantindo que todos se sintam ouvidos. Você utiliza insights dos clientes para impulsionar e orientar o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam constantemente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação Técnica em Automação;
  • Ter experiênciacomprovada na área de automação industrial;
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Local de trabalho: Sorocaba - SP;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide:

  • Who gets funded
  • How and when we collect
  • Where we allocate risk capital

You’ll report to the Head of Risk and collaborate closely with our data science and engineering team. You’ll work across the entire risk lifecycle - from first impression to final repayment - applying data science to maximize portfolio performance and capital efficiency.

Your focus: deliver models and systems that make better decisions, earlier.


Specifically, you will:

  • Model borrower risk : Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
  • Detect and prevent fraud : Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors - from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
  • Prioritize recovery actions : Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting - so we know who to contact, how , and when .
  • Design experiments : Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies - not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
  • Deploy your work : Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
  • Create leverage : Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
  • Strong command of SQL , Python , and the practical use of ML techniques (e.G., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
  • Experience deploying models in production - including versioning, validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.

We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.

  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

title: General Manager Of South America Region
description:

Location:São Paulo, Brazil (or key city in primary operating country).

Extensive travel within South America is required.

Employment Type: Full-time


About Star Charge:

Star Charge is a global leader in electric vehicle charging equipment manufacturing and charging network operation. We are committed to building a worldwide new energy mobility service network through innovative technology and services. We are actively expanding into the South American market and seeking a visionary and experienced leader

to drive the full-scale development of our business in the region from zero to one and beyond.


Position Summary:

As the General Manager for the South America Region, you will be fully responsible for developing and executing the overall strategy for Star Charge in South America, achieving rapid growth in market share, revenue, and profitability. You will be the business founder and core leader, establishing local operations, managing government relations, strategic partnerships, market expansion, sales delivery, and service operations.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategy & Planning:

Develop long-term market development strategy, annual business plans, and financial budgets for the South America region. Conduct in-depth analysis of policy environments, competitive landscapes, customer needs, and industry trends in key South American

countries (e.G., Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Argentina). Identify market opportunities and potential risks, formulating corresponding market entry and competitive strategies.

2. Business Development & Sales:

Lead and personally engage in acquiring, negotiating with, and maintaining relationships with key clients (e.G., OEMs, energy companies, large commercial real estate, retail chains, government projects). Establish and manage a diversified sales channel network, including direct sales, distributors, and strategic partners. Lead major project bidding to ensure regional sales and market share targets are achieved.

3. Operations & Localization Management:

Oversee the daily operations of the South American subsidiary. Establish and optimize the local team structure, business processes, financial and compliance systems. Supervise the construction, operation, and maintenance quality of the charging network, ensuring excellent user experience and service reliability.

4. Government Relations & Public Affairs:

Represent the company to build and maintain strong relationships with government bodies, industry associations, and media across South American countries. Closely monitor and proactively influence policies and standards related to EVs and charging infrastructure.

5. Team Building & Leadership:

Recruit, develop, motivate, and manage a high-performing local team, fostering a positive and efficient organizational culture. Act as the bridge between the regional team and global headquarters, ensuring strategic alignment and resource synergy.


Qualifications & Requirements:

1. Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree or above;
MBA, Engineering, Economics, or related field preferred. Minimum 10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years in a general management or senior business development role in South America. Experience in new energy, automotive, energy infrastructure, industrial products, or technology sectors is highly preferred. Proven track record of successfully building a new market or business line from scratch.

2. Competencies & Skills:

Exceptional Business Acumen & Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop clear business strategies and execute effectively.

Outstanding Sales & Negotiation Skills: Proven history of closing large contracts or strategic partnerships.

Strong Leadership & Team Management:Ability to lead diverse, cross-cultural teams.

Excellent Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Proficiency in engaging with government officials, C-level executives, and internal/external stakeholders.

Solid Financial & Analytical Skills: P&L ownership and data-driven decision-making capability.

Strong Problem-Solving & Resilience: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic market environment.

3. Language Requirements:

Fluency in English and Spanish is mandatory.

4. Others:

Passion for the new energy industry and alignment with the

company's vision.

Willingness to be based in South America long-term and travel

extensively.

CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil .
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks .
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts .
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics .
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.


Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries , including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies .
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic .
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function , not just an operator.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.


But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

A força motriz por trás de nós é o grupo diversificado e talentoso em todo o mundo que traz sua paixão e experiência para o trabalho todos os dias. E embora sejamos uma organização verdadeiramente global, permanecemos profundamente enraizados nas comunidades em que operamos e em que nosso pessoal vive e trabalha.

Valorizamos ser inclusivos. Abraçamos e celebramos a diversidade de cada um de nossos funcionários. E com cada novo membro de nossa equipe, ficamos ainda mais fortes. Nossas estrelas estão se alinhando. Então junte-se a nossa equipe e aspire pela grandeza.



PRINCIPAIS DESAFIOS:


- Auditar os processos de produção dos fornecedores;

- Monitorar as tendências dos principais indicadores de qualidade dos fornecedores (LISTA DE LICITAÇÕES);

- Gerenciar o processo de escalonamento, de acordo com as ferramentas de restauração da confiabilidade do processo do fornecedor, como SUPREL, CSL e Escalonamentos;

- Apoiar outras áreas de compras (Operacional, DP, TAG) em relação às provisões técnicas e estruturais da base de fornecedores;

- Monitorar e validar os planos de ação corretiva com os fornecedores, decorrentes de reclamações oficiais de clientes.

- Avaliar novas fontes de fornecimento por meio de NSA;

- Participar da Revisão Técnica;

- Verificar a adequação dos meios e equipamentos de teste, validar os planos de teste no início e no final da autoqualificação;

- Monitorar o desenvolvimento do APQP e PPAP com o processo do fornecedor;

- Auditar a adequação dos processos do fornecedor (Auditoria de Processos);

- Avaliar a capacidade produtiva do processo do fornecedor por meio do CAT;
- Gerenciar junto aos fornecedores a entrega de amostras de acordo com as condições de cada projeto;

Desenvolver ferramentas como AQR para proteger principalmente a segurança e as partes críticas.



REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS:


-Superior completo;

-Inglês básico.


Na Stellantis, avaliamos os candidatos com base em qualificações, mérito e necessidades do negócio. Acolhemos candidaturas de pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, idade, etnia, nacionalidade, religião, orientação sexual e deficiência. Equipes diversas nos permitirão responder melhor às necessidades emergentes dos nossos clientes e cuidar do nosso futuro.

Venha fazer parte!

The vacancy is remote and the candidate should be based in Belo Horizonte. The role may require occasional travelling in Brazil.

Please, submit your CV in English when applying for this vacancy.


Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive, passionate, and dedicated Account Manager to act as the main point of contact between our clients and internal teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong focus on client satisfaction, relationship management, and operational excellence, ensuring that each client receives outstanding support and value from our products and services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary contact for client needs, inquiries, and concerns.
  • Build and nurture strong client relationships to foster retention and growth.
  • Oversee client accounts, ensuring services meet business goals, expectations, and budgets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams — including sales, product, and operations — to deliver tailored solutions.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues, continuously improving client experience and internal processes.
  • Work closely with the product team to align updates and features with client expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Altenar’s offerings to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients, ensuring a seamless and positive partnership.


Requirements & Skills:

  • Languages: Portuguese (proficient), English (intermediate or higher).
  • Previous experience in account management, sales, or customer service .
  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to collect, track, and interpret data effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Problem-solving attitude and adaptability in fast-paced environments.
  • Proven ability to build rapport and collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Experience in the sports betting or iGaming industry is a strong advantage.


What We Offer

  • A stable, flexible, and collaborative working environment.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational team of industry experts from around the world.

title: Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)
description:
Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil


Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: February 11, 2026

Closing date: Open until filled


Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?


If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.


About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.


IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore;
as such, major industryleaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.


Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics


Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics


Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills;
    fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments


Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel;
    candidates are requiredto have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays


Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data


WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need .


HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

title: Compensation & Benefits Manager
description:
ABOUT COTY


Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. They celebrate and foster a culture of kindness and pride themselves on offering equal opportunities. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team. As part of their commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome at Coty.

Join Coty and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to shaping the future of the beauty industry in Latin America through a unique footprint. Apply now to contribute your expertise and passion for technology and to drive digital transformation into our business success!


JOB OVERVIEW


This is a role for someone ready to take the next step. As a Compensation & Benefits Manager, you will lead a team, own key C&B processes, and play a critical role in building the governance and structures that support our people strategy connecting data, business needs, and human decisions.


You will act as a trusted partner and mediator, bridging HR, Finance, and business areas ensuring that C&B processes run smoothly, decisions are well-grounded, and communication with leaders, HRBPs, and employees is always clear and consistent.


You will ensure that our compensation structures and benefits packages are competitive, compliant, and aligned with organizational strategy, while building a team culture of rigor, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Lead, develop, and engage your team fostering autonomy, accountability, and technical growth in each team member;
  • Design and sustain global compensation processes that support performance, equity, and talent retention;
  • Conduct compensation benchmarking analyses and present results to global stakeholders, supporting informed decisions on salary structures;
  • Partner with leadership to review and adjust salary structures, acting as a key mediator between business needs and HR governance;
  • Develop and maintain policies, guidelines, and processes for C&B, ensuring clarity and consistency across the organization;
  • Create communication and training materials that help leaders, HRBPs, and employees navigate C&B practices with confidence;
  • Manage comprehensive benefits programs (healthcare, dental, wellbeing, and non-monetary benefits), including end-to-end vendor and supplier management, from contract negotiations to ongoing relationship governance;
  • Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of benefits programs, bringing a critical eye to what works and proposing data-driven improvements;
  • Monitor healthcare claims ratio (loss ratio) through monthly analyses and lead preventive and corrective actions in partnership with the health area to optimize costs and strengthen contractual negotiations;
  • Ensure full compliance of C&B programs with labor legislation and local regulations;
  • Keep C&B records current and accurate, preparing reports that meet internal and external audit standards;
  • Own and controlall personnel costs, including annual budget, forecasting, monthly business review reporting, efficiency initiatives, labor capitalization, and provisions;
  • Ensure transparent and reliable information flow with leadership, the team, and HRBPs, building trust through clarity and consistency.


REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Human Resources, or related fields;

Good experience of compensation and benefits practices, market references, and local regulations;

Previous experience leading teams;

Strong analyticalprofile, comfortable with data, budgets, and process structuring;

Strong communication and negotiation skills, you can influence without imposing, and mediate without losing direction;

Organized, detail-oriented, and able to think systemically, keeping multiple fronts moving without losing the bigger picture;

Availability to work in a hybrid model (2 days per week on-site);

Advanced English (mandatory);

High energy, ownership mindset, and genuine drive to grow, this role is a real opportunity to build your management career in a structured, meaningful environment.
